content.summary: Reviewed source closure, two extraction algorithms, exact span coverage and the explicit-reference completeness boundary. Tests include retained 23EC46 and executable missing annex/footnote cases.
findings: Acquisition uses only official HTTPS hosts and inherited DNS pinning; caps and cycles remain findings.
Packet completeness is measured against retained raw-document extraction, not candidate labels.
Unlinked prose authorities remain a semantic inventory responsibility; explicit references alone do not certify completeness.
Independent HTML tokenization and PDF Poppler extraction do not share the primary parser; discrepancies remain visible.
No model calls or external legal opinion are required for this phase.
